neighbours.label: The token right before a comparison operator is due: 'p' inside a statistics parenthesis ('(p < 0.05)', '(all p > 0.05)'), and in code the variable after 'if' that is about to be compared. The output direction promotes '<', '>' and '≤'. Tested on the statistics case.
fire: Recall was higher in the training group than in controls (p < 0.01).
Blood pressure fell more with the new drug than with placebo (p = 0.03).
Scores did not differ between the two schools (all p > 0.10).
Women reported more sleep problems than men (p < 0.001).
The effect of age on reaction time was reliable (p < 0.05).
Neither dose changed heart rate compared with baseline (both p > 0.20).
Survival at five years was better in the surgery arm (p = 0.04).
Error rates rose with task difficulty in every group (all p < 0.01).
quiet: Recall was higher in the training group than in controls (see Table 2).
Blood pressure fell more with the new drug than with placebo (Figure 3).
Scores did not differ between the two schools (data not shown).
Women reported more sleep problems than men (see the appendix).
The effect of age on reaction time was reliable (replicated twice).
Neither dose changed heart rate compared with baseline (see Methods).
Survival at five years was better in the surgery arm (reported earlier).
Error rates rose with task difficulty in every group (as expected).

notes: Probe: text ending in '(p' 0.32, '(all p' 0.47, 'if x' 0.21; a bare ' (' before an age range 0.16; code without comparison ~0. Near misses keep the result sentence and the parenthesis but put no statistic in it.
